The '''LEC 2020 Spring Split''' was the first split of the 2020 [[League of Legends European Championship]] season, organized by Riot Games and held from January 24 to April 19, 2020. The season featured ten franchise teams competing in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Double Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoffs to determine the European champion. The winner of the split qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2020|2020 Mid-Season Invitational]] as Europe’s representative.

Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, matches were moved to an online format starting in March 2020, marking the first time in league history that the Playoffs were held remotely.

===Playoffs===
{{#lst:LEC/2020/Spring/Playoffs|Playoffs}}


==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''January 24th - March 28th, 2020''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**1st to 6th place will play the Playoffs
***1st to 4th place are seeded into Semifinals
***5h and 6th place are seeded into Losers' Round 1
* '''Playoffs''' - ''April 3rd - April 19th, 2020''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2020|Mid-Season Invitational 2020]]
